In summary, our research is concerned with
the neural basis of the selective retrieval of conceptual knowledge.
the neural underpinnings of attentional processes that guide semantic memory retrieval.
the neural basis of attention in semantic cognition, and in particular, the role of parietal cortex.

the posterior parietal lobe (PPL) is a crucial component in the neural circuitry that supports the control of attentional processes during semantic retrieval.

posterior parietal areas, in addition to ventrolateral pre-frontal and posterior temporal regions, contribute to semantic control by modulating the attentional salience of goal-relevant features of meaning.
